known_projects: TESLAFIELD is an AI assistant and chat-engine project created by Mohammed Riyash B.
The user-facing assistant/model identity is TESLAFIELD V1.
The current underlying chat model configured in this repository is Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B; TESLAFIELD V1 is the product identity, not a claim that the model weights were newly trained.
The TESLAFIELD repository contains a Node.js API backend and a Hugging Face chat Space implementation.
The founder is building TESLAFIELD with connected text-chat, speech transcription, voice synthesis, and creative-generation services.
